About us

Modest, considered, threaded with care

Threaded began with a simple idea: modest dress should feel considered as well as look it. Each abaya starts with a clean line and a fabric chosen for how it falls. We keep the detailing quiet so the cut does the talking.

FAQ

Good to know

How do I order?

Open a piece, enter your details and measurements, then send your order. We will get back to you to confirm.

When is my order confirmed?

Once payment has been received.

How can I pay?

By bank transfer or STC Pay.

Can I return or exchange?

Refund and exchange are available. Custom orders are not refundable.

What about alterations?

Every custom order includes one free alteration.

How to measure

Measure in inches over light clothing. Length: from top of shoulder to the hem you want. Shoulder: edge to edge across the back. Sleeve: shoulder to wrist. Bust, waist, hips: around the fullest point. Check twice.
